bounds: A stable three-row SQL snapshot contains one ordinary embedding row, one source-segment row with a media reference and one orphan source segment. A complete ordinary read hides source rows; the explicit source read returns both. All reads and writes succeed. Concurrent insertion/deletion, adapter failures, multiple pages and crash recovery are outside this projection. The real SQL/runtime test checks inclusion, uniqueness, media collection and wipe; it does not enumerate concurrent schedules.

assumptions: Each enabled read, collection or parser step eventually executes and settles (weak fairness). No wall-clock bound is proved.
No fairness is assumed. The environment may indefinitely delay the next enabled step.
